Non-Stop 60-Hour Battery Life: Keep the music flowing for nearly three full days without ever reaching for a power outlet. This is a lifesaver for those back-to-back work calls followed by long gym sessions and late-night gaming. You can literally go through your entire Monday-to-Friday grind on a single charge, removing the "low battery anxiety" from your daily routine. 13 mm Drivers for Deep Bass: Get ready for high-octane audio powered by massive 13 mm drivers that specialize in deep, thumping bass. These are tuned specifically for those who want to feel the vibration of every beat in their soul. It’s the perfect companion for your morning commute, turning a dull subway ride into an energetic, private concert. Full Customization via boAt Hearables App: Unlock the true potential of your hardware with a dedicated app that lets you tweak your buds to your liking. From updating firmware to remapping your touch gestures, it puts the control in your pocket. If you’re someone who constantly misplaces things, the "Ring My Buds" feature will save you minutes of searching under couch cushions every single morning. Dual Pairing Multipoint Connectivity: Manage your digital life across two devices simultaneously without the headache of manual switching. Imagine you’re deep into a playlist on your laptop while working, but your mom calls your phone, the Airdopes Plus 222 will intelligently switch the audio to your phone and back again once you hang up. It’s seamless multitasking for the modern professional. In fast-paced shooters, those few milliseconds of lag can be the difference between winning and losing. With BEAST Mode active, the audio hits your ears the exact moment the action happens on screen, ensuring your reflexes are never held back by your tech. Access to Voice Assistant: Navigate your world using just your voice by instantly triggering Siri or Google Assistant. It’s like having a hands-free personal helper that never leaves your side. AI-ENx Technology: Experience boardroom-quality clarity on every call thanks to dual mics that filter out the world's noise. Even if you're walking through a gusty park, the AI-ENx tech ensures your voice stays front and center. Insta Wake N’Pair (IWP): With IWP, you can instantly connect to the sound when you open the case lid and plug in your earbuds. Enjoy podcasts, web series, and movies without pesky connectivity delay. IPX4-Rated Sweat & Splash Guard: Don’t let a little rain or a heavy workout session stop your rhythm. These earbuds are engineered to withstand splashes of daily life, so you can push your limits on the track without worrying about moisture damage. They are built to be as resilient as your toughest training day.
